ambiguities: Cottard's speech is addressed to Forcheville and driven by his preoccupation with 'la noblesse de Forcheville,' which could be read as a faint elevation of Forcheville (as someone worth impressing), but this is subsumed in the already-captured movement (Cottard's own obsequiousness) and gives Forcheville no distinct outcome of his own, so it was not scored.

The passing remark that the baroness Putbus 'connaît du reste Mme Verdurin, je crois' could suggest a faint prestige association for Mme Verdurin, but the mention is hedged ('je crois'), incidental to Cottard's name-dropping, and too minor to constitute a material local event.
